reforms.description: The Canadian federal government proposed a budget aimed at reducing unemployment while combating inflation, which included measures such as accelerated depreciation for machinery and equipment, a reduction in the corporate tax rate from 49% to 40%, and a reduction in income tax for small businesses from 25% to 20% to stimulate business investment and support their growth.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The proposed tax reductions and incentives are designed to stimulate business investment and support the growth of small businesses, which can enhance productivity and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The budget proposals were announced as part of the government's economic strategy.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms are significant in their intent to stimulate investment and support small businesses, but they do not represent a structural overhaul of the innovation system.
reforms.source_quote: Le Gouvernement fédéral a indiqué que son principal objectif était de réduire sensiblement le chômage tout en luttant contre l'inflation.
